 Judgment

It is recorded before the Lok-Adalat on 14.08.2021 that the parties have filed a joint memo as the matter was settled out of the Court and the decree holders/claimants have received the compensation amount from the judgment debtor in the presence of their counsel and the claimants agreed to withdraw the appeal in MFA No.3503/2018 and that they would not file any appeal for enhancement.
It is observed that, taking the memo into consideration, the said petition was dismissed as fully satisfied.
2. Considering the above, as the matter is settled before the Lok-Adalat, all three appeals are disposed of.
